_note: One line per picture: what ACTUALLY HAPPENS in it. Sophie's rule for this pass — earlier animation passes only wobbled hair and edges, which reads as a broken still. Every line here names a real event with a beginning and an end, and none of them is dramatic; the camera does not move.
dp-heart-spectrum-a: the single lit slice of the spectrum band slowly widens and brightens, and the small figure turns its head to follow it
dp-heart-spectrum-b: the faint ripples travel steadily across the room from left to right, passing through the wall and through the seated man
dp-heart-mechanism-d: the standing luminous figure lifts its head and looks up and away from the sleeping body, and the last field lines around the bed fade out
dp-heart-mechanism-a: the concentric field lines flow continuously up out of his chest, over his head and down around him, and the heart at the centre pulses slowly
dp-heart-mechanism-b: the field lines draw tighter and closer around the body, and the luminous figure inside is pressed and held still by them
dp-heart-paralysis-a: the man on the bed opens his eyes wide while the rest of his body stays completely motionless, and the room darkens around him
dp-heart-paralysis-b: the long wave line rolls slowly across the room from one side to the other, and the clock hand creeps forward and stops
dp-heart-paralysis-c: the wave line snaps into fast jagged spikes and the luminous figure is pulled sharply back down into the body on the bed
dp-heart-mechanism-c: the luminous figure rises slowly up and out of the seated body, shoulders first, and the field lines thin away to nothing
dp-heart-paralysis-d: the luminous figure sinks steadily downward through the floor and the bed and the room fall away below it
dp-heart-soul-physical-a: his two hands rub together in front of his face, and his eyes move to follow them
dp-heart-soul-physical-b: he turns his head slowly to look down at his own sleeping body on the bed, and the sleeping chest rises and falls
dp-heart-soul-physical-c: he drifts slowly along the side of the parked car with his hand trailing on the metal, and rain falls through the streetlight
dp-heart-soul-physical-d: the two of them look at each other and the older figure slowly raises a hand in greeting
dp-heart-spectrum-c: the cat's head turns slowly to track something moving across the empty corner, and its ears swivel with it
dp-heart-spectrum-d: the crowd of unseen figures drifts slowly through the living room around the seated man, passing behind and in front of the furniture
dp-heart-field-analogies-a: light travels out along the cable from the computer and spreads through the whole web of lines behind it
dp-heart-field-analogies-b: the man on the telephone turns his head, and above him the small tents flap in the wind and their lanterns swing
dp-heart-field-analogies-c: the dark mould in the right jar spreads and creeps up the glass while the left jar stays clean
dp-heart-field-analogies-d: the lit house glows steadily while the abandoned house beside it sags, its grass grows up and a shutter falls
dp-heart-energy-c: the water runs down the stone channel and turns steadily in the vortex, and fine lines rise off the spinning surface
dp-heart-energy-d: the DNA strand rotates slowly on its axis and the caps at each end glow brighter and dimmer in turn
dp-heart-energy-a: the balloon drifts and tugs on its wire, and a charge crawls visibly down the length of the wire into the ground rod
dp-proof-accounts-c: a hand comes into frame and adds a tick to the notebook column, then turns the page
dp-proof-friends-tv: the two friends shift in their chairs watching the television, its picture changing, while the luminous man stands still and watches the screen
dp-proof-overheard: the two friends talk to each other across the table, gesturing, while the luminous figure between them turns its head from one to the other
dp-proof-whiteboard-a: the hand finishes writing the numeral on the whiteboard, lowers, and leaves the frame
dp-proof-whiteboard-b: the luminous man drifts closer to the whiteboard and leans in to read the numeral
dp-proof-whiteboard-c: he sits on the edge of the bed speaking into the telephone, and his free hand moves as he says the number
dp-proof-whiteboard-d: the five whiteboards stand in a row and the light moves slowly across them one after another
dp-proof-group-slip: the fingers fold the slip of paper closed and the fist tightens around it, while the watching people lean in
dp-proof-science-empty-chair: the instruments around the empty chair turn slightly, adjusting, all of them settling to aim at the seat
dp-proof-statements: the loose pages of the stack lift and settle in a draught, and the pile grows taller
dp-proof-accounts-d: the crowd shifts and breathes, more figures becoming visible at the back, all of them facing forward
dp-proof-accounts-a: the luminous woman hangs in the air above the camp and turns her head to follow the small figure moving between the tents below
dp-proof-son-camp: the young soldier walks slowly away between the tents carrying his mug, and the camp lights come on behind him
dp-proof-accounts-b: she lowers her hand from her mouth and grips the phone tighter, listening
dp-proof-agency-window: clouds move slowly behind the building and the one lit window stays steady while a second window lights up
dp-proof-viewing-room: the seated person keeps their eyes closed and their hands flat while the observer opposite writes steadily on the notepad
dp-proof-files: the open drawer slides further out and a hand lifts one folder up out of the packed row
dp-pyramid-tunnels-a: the luminous man descends slowly through the night air toward the pyramids below him
dp-pyramid-tunnels-b: the cutaway view sinks downward, revealing more shafts and chambers below the pyramid as it goes
dp-pyramid-tunnels-c: the huge wound coils turn slowly in the rock chamber and the small figure at their base walks forward
dp-pyramid-tunnels-d: the floodlights in the shafts come on one by one and the small working figures move along the tunnels
dp-heart-more-a-a: the loose cable on the floor lies still while the computer's screen flickers on alone, lighting nothing
dp-heart-more-a-b: the single line of light between the two distant figures brightens and pulses along its length from one to the other
dp-heart-more-a-c: the rings on the surface of the water spread outward from the centre and reach the glass
dp-heart-more-a-d: dust drifts through the light in the empty room and a patch of damp spreads slowly up the wallpaper
dp-heart-more-b-a: light runs along the lines of the vast web, branching outward past the small figure standing inside it
dp-heart-more-b-b: the crowd walks on down the street while the soft shapes above them drift from one person's head to another's
dp-heart-more-b-c: the dark jar's mould thickens and climbs while the pale jar beside it stays exactly as it is
dp-heart-more-b-d: the figure on the bed lies still while the light through the window dims and dust settles over everything
